nodes.label: Graphify Workflow
nodes.rationale: Use the persistent graph and update it after code changes so architectural context remains available and current.

nodes.label: Service Start Order
nodes.rationale: MCP must serve data before invoice and music A2A agents run, and those agents must be available before the planner CLI dispatches requests.

nodes.label: Domain Boundary Rule
nodes.rationale: Invoice and music agents remain domain-focused and use MCP for data; planning, routing, HITL, and aggregation remain in their owning layers.

nodes.label: Runtime Architecture Flow
nodes.rationale: User requests are planned into structured tasks, optionally resumed through HITL, executed through A2A and MCP, then formatted by the aggregator.

nodes.label: HITL Interrupt And Resume
nodes.rationale: Interrupts resume the same LangGraph thread so a user's missing information completes the in-progress workflow.

nodes.label: Task Args Source Of Truth
nodes.rationale: Execution rebuilds instructions from structured task args rather than relying on stale planner instruction text.

nodes.label: Text-Compatible A2A Instruction
nodes.rationale: Current A2A services still accept text, so structured payloads retain an instruction field as a compatibility contract until structured transport is proven.

nodes.label: Invoice Support Employee Enrichment Rule
nodes.rationale: Every invoice returned for a customer must include the support employee associated with that invoice.

nodes.label: Sequential Multi-Agent Execution
nodes.rationale: The current invoice-then-music flow remains sequential because it is easier to debug while text-based domain parsing is still in use.

nodes.label: Parallel Multi-Agent Execution
nodes.rationale: Parallel execution is deferred until structured payloads replace most domain text parsing because parallel state merging is harder to debug.

nodes.label: Multi-Agent System With LangGraph A2A And MCP
nodes.norm_label: multi-agent system with langgraph a2a and mcp

nodes.label: Design Principles
nodes.rationale: Planning, missing-information collection, data access, domain execution, and final formatting are assigned to separate responsible components.

nodes.label: Human-In-The-Loop Interrupts
nodes.rationale: Missing required values are collected by interrupting and resuming the same graph thread rather than guessing.

nodes.label: MCP Tools Only Access Data
nodes.rationale: MCP tools provide database access and must not own planning, routing, HITL, or aggregation logic.

nodes.label: Structured A2A Payload Support
nodes.rationale: Structured A2A payload support is a planned improvement so agents no longer need to parse generated text instructions.

nodes.label: A2A JSON-RPC Message Contract
nodes.rationale: The reusable A2A client sends SendMessage JSON-RPC requests and normalizes either nested or direct response parts into text while rejecting malformed responses.

nodes.label: Invoice Agent Prompt Contract
nodes.rationale: The invoice agent is restricted to invoice concerns, requires customer_id, selects the most specific intent, enriches invoices with support employees, and must not invent records.
